After p5-q1-f, add one instruction: “Predict the sign between the terms before expanding.” Add (g) sin(2x + y), answer sin2x cos y + cos2x sin y; (h) sin(2x − y), answer sin2x cos y − cos2x sin y; (i) cos(2x + y), answer cos2x cos y − sin2x sin y; (j) cos(2x − y), answer cos2x cos y + sin2x sin y. [Pedagogy review · Suggestion · variation-sequence · pf-b803441b17]
After p12-q3-d, add one instruction: “Predict which answers will stay the same before calculating.” Add (e) If sin x = 3/5 and x is acute, find sin2x and cos2x. Answers: 24/25, 7/25. (f) If sin x = 3/5 and x is obtuse, find sin2x and cos2x. Answers: −24/25, 7/25. (g) If sin x = −3/5 and π < x < 3π/2, find sin2x and cos2x. Answers: 24/25, 7/25. (h) If sin x = −3/5 and −π/2 < x < 0, find sin2x and cos2x. Answers: −24/25, 7/25. Follow with (i) If cos x = −5/13 and x is obtuse, find sin2x and cos2x. Answers: −120/169, −119/169. Through the matched run, |sin x| stays fixed and the quadrant changes.
